candidates.name: Cable Rope Face Pulls
candidates.cardText:
Cable Rope Face Pulls
Novice
1
Facing the pulley, pull the weight towards you while keeping your arms parallel to the ground.
2
Pull your hands back to both sides of your head and hold the position.
3
Slowly return weight to starting position. Repeat.

candidates.name: Cable High Single Arm Rear Delt Fly
candidates.cardText:
Cable High Single Arm Rear Delt Fly
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment or no attachment at all. The cable should be set to the top.
2
Walk a few steps away with the cable coming from the opposing side of the working arm.
3
From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct, while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

candidates.name: Cable Single Arm Rear Delt Row
candidates.cardText:
Cable Single Arm Rear Delt Row
Advanced
1
Use a handle attachment, grab with an overhand grip and take a position with the cable crossing your body.
2
Pull your elbows back while flaring your elbows outward.

candidates.name: Cable Supinating Row
candidates.cardText:
Cable Supinating Row
Beginner
1
Place the cable at shoulder height.
2
Start with an overhand grip. As you pull your elbow back, rotate your palm until it faces upward.

candidates.name: Cable Archer Row
candidates.cardText:
Cable Archer Row
Intermediate
1
Place the cable at shoulder height.
2
On the same side as the working arm, step back and rotate outwards.
3
Pull your elbow back while flaring your elbow out.

candidates.name: Cable Rope Kneeling Face Pull
candidates.cardText:
Cable Rope Kneeling Face Pull
Novice
1
Start with the cables at the top. Use a rope attachment. Fall to a half kneeling position.
2
Pull the metal piece in the middle of the rope to the bridge of your nose.

candidates.name: Cable High Reverse Fly
candidates.cardText:
Cable High Reverse Fly
Novice
1
Use a handle attachment or no attachment at all. The cable should be set to the top.
2
Walk a few steps away with the cable coming from the opposing side of the working arm.
3
From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct, while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

candidates.name: Cable Single Arm Internally Rotated High Reverse Fly
candidates.cardText:
Cable Single Arm Internally Rotated High Reverse Fly
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment or no attachment at all. The cable should be set to the top.
2
Walk a few steps away with the cable coming from the opposing side of the working arms. Internally rotate the shoulders.
3
From there, your shoulder should horizontally abduct and adduct, while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

candidates.name: Cable High Internally Rotated Reverse Fly
candidates.cardText:
Cable High Internally Rotated Reverse Fly
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment or no attachment at all. The cable should be set to the top.
2
Walk a few steps away with the cable coming from the opposing side of the working arms. Internally rotate the shoulders.
3
From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct, while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

candidates.name: Cable External Rotation
candidates.cardText:
Cable External Rotation
Beginner
1
Hold the cable handle in one hand, elbow bent at 90 degrees going across your torso.
2
Rotate your arm outward, keeping your elbow stable.

candidates.name: Cable Bar Face Pull
candidates.cardText:
Cable Bar Face Pull
Novice
1
Facing the pulley, pull the weight towards you while keeping your arms parallel to the ground.
2
Pull your hands back to both sides of your head and hold the position.
3
Slowly return weight to starting position. Repeat.

candidates.name: Cable Seated Bar Face Pull
candidates.cardText:
Cable Seated Bar Face Pull
Novice
1
Sit facing cable machine and grasp bar with shoulder-width overhand grip.
2
Pull bar toward upper face while driving elbows outward and back.
3
Squeeze rear delts at the end, then return bar slowly with control.

candidates.name: Cable Seated Rope Face Pull
candidates.cardText:
Cable Seated Rope Face Pull
Novice
1
Sit facing cable and hold rope with palms facing each other, arms extended.
2
Pull rope toward upper face while flaring elbows outward.
3
Squeeze rear delts and mid-traps, then slowly return to start.

candidates.name: Cable Seated Single Arm Face Pull
candidates.cardText:
Cable Seated Single Arm Face Pull
Novice
1
Sit facing cable and hold handle with arm extended at shoulder height.
2
Pull handle toward upper face while driving elbow outward and back.
3
Squeeze rear delt, then return slowly, maintaining control.

candidates.name: Cable Standing Single Arm Cross Rear Delt Row
candidates.cardText:
Cable Standing Single Arm Cross Rear Delt Row
Beginner
1
Stand sideways to cable and hold handle across your body at opposite side.
2
Pull handle outward and back, leading with elbow and keeping arm slightly bent.
3
Squeeze rear delt at the end, then return slowly with control.

candidates.name: Cable Single Arm Face Pull
candidates.cardText:
Cable Single Arm Face Pull
Novice
1
Stand facing cable and hold handle at shoulder height with arm extended.
2
Pull handle toward upper face while driving elbow outward and back.
3
Squeeze rear delt at the end, then return slowly with control.
